image_description: A small, slender weasel with reddish-brown dorsal fur and lighter ventral fur is perched on a mossy rock in a natural setting. The animal has a pointed snout, dark eyes, short rounded ears, and short legs. Its body is elongated and tubular, typical of mustelids. The background consists of blurred vegetation and rocks.
